scientific_question: Can a single camera-set-derived anisotropic H1 penalty rescue every five-camera temporal stratum while preserving the frozen seven- and nine-camera adequacy gates?
role: post-open private controlled-proxy geometry mechanism diagnostic; not a learned method, not true experimental pairing, and not a deployment or resource result
physical_hypothesis: Sparse-view failures may reflect directional observability imbalance rather than excessive global smoothness. A world-axis derivative weakly transverse to the active camera rays is regularized more strongly, while well-observed derivative axes are regularized less strongly.

v160.interpretation: half-order regularization worsened every five-camera gradient tail, closing the oversmoothing explanation and post-hoc Sobolev-order search

source_semantics.density_output: first TorchScript output is the reconstructed density field; require finite values only and apply no clipping or offset
source_semantics.synthetic_pairing: camera-field pairing and two-component observations are generated by code for the controlled proxy; no true experiment pairing is inferred
source_semantics.source: direct clarification from the supervising senior on 2026-08-18

inputs.models: the same nine CPU-adapted TorchScript models sealed by v157-v160
inputs.calibrations: the same thirteen nine-camera JSON files sealed by v157-v160

representation.field_subspace: zero-mean DCT 16x8x8 excluding the constant coefficient
representation.ray_source: the unit world-frame ray directions that enter the frozen forward for each active camera and 24x24 detector target grid
representation.axis_transverse_sensitivity: s_j = mean over active cameras and rays of (1 - d_j^2)
representation.primary_penalty: sum_j w_j * (pi*k_j/span_j)^2, normalized to median one over the 1023 positive DCT modes
representation.comparison_penalty: the frozen isotropic H1 penalty sum_j (pi*k_j/span_j)^2, normalized to median one
representation.permutation_contract: reordering active cameras or rays cannot change s, w, the primary penalty, or the reconstructed field beyond 1e-12 relative
representation.variable_cardinality: weights are rebuilt separately from the fixed 5-, 7-, and 9-camera active sets
representation.forbidden_variants: no central-ray substitute, learned weight, sensitivity exponent, weight clipping, alternative floor, alternative normalization, alternate multiplier, or per-sample selector

regularization.origin: held identical to v159-v160 after median-normalizing the geometry-derived penalty; not selected from v161 results

metrics: p50/p90-higher/worst by time, arm, and camera count
axis sensitivities and weights by calibration and camera count

cost_accounting.geometry_setup: 1023 exact nine-camera A-equivalent basis projections per calibration; all camera subsets, arms, models, and times reuse sealed geometry
cost_accounting.geometry_weight_construction: geometry-only reductions over at most 9x24x24 unit rays; zero A and zero A-transpose
cost_accounting.primary_online_after_geometry_cache: one exact reduced A-transpose equivalent for B^T y and one exact reduced A equivalent for the final projection
cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden until a later fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate

independent_recomputation.physics: rebuild camera rays and sparse operators with the independent v156 numerical path
independent_recomputation.basis: analytic cosine products rather than scipy idctn basis construction
independent_recomputation.geometry_weights: explicit scalar accumulation of 1-d_j^2 over independently reconstructed active rays, followed by log-domain geometric mean
required_comparisons: the frozen v159.1 H1 control rows and summaries

decision_order: Any input, source-semantics, operator, basis, ray, sensitivity, weight, penalty, density, stationarity, residual, accounting, historical-control, permutation, or independent-recomputation failure makes v161 inconclusive.
Only the frozen inverse-transverse-sensitivity diagonal H1 and multiplier 0.03 are primary; no alternative may replace them after results.

The primary passes only if every one of the twelve time-by-camera strata passes all absolute gates, each nine-camera stratum satisfies parent no-harm, and the formerly failed t=0.75 five-camera gradient p90 is strictly lower than the frozen H1 value.
A valid failure closes this diagonal geometry-anisotropy mechanism and does not authorize weight tuning, a larger model, or GPU rescue.

A valid pass establishes only controlled-proxy temporal reference adequacy and authorizes a separately frozen minimal CPU observation-only predictor diagnostic; it is not real BOST, external generalization, or a resource result.
